operatorProperties.code:
def process(fireWeather) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = fireWeather.copy()

    # Overall average fatalities per record/day
    overall_avg = df['fatalities_last'].mean()

    low_hum_avg = df.loc[df['avrh_mean'] < 30, 'fatalities_last'].mean()

    diff = low_hum_avg - overall_avg

    return pd.DataFrame([
        {
            'overall_avg_fatalities': overall_avg,
            'lowHumidity_avg_fatalities': low_hum_avg,
            'diff_lowMinusOverall': diff,
            'diff_rounded_4dp': round(diff, 4),
            'n_total': len(df),
            'n_lowHumidity': int((df['avrh_mean'] < 30).sum()),
        }
    ])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute overall mean of fatalities_last across all records; compute mean fatalities_last for subset with avrh_mean (average relative humidity) < 30%; calculate difference (low-humidity mean minus overall mean) and round to 4 decimals; also return counts of total records and low-humidity records for context
